## [Unreleased]

### Added

- Navigation transactions: `NavOp` (`Push`/`Replace`/`Back`/`Forward`/`Go`)
  batches applied atomically by `RouterCore::transact` with exactly one
  re-render; `RouterState::transact` adds the event pair and a blocker-aware
  fallback, `Navigator::transact` is the ergonomic entry point. Unmatched
  pushes produce `NotFound` and leave history untouched.
- `nested-search` feature (forwarded by `navi-router`): typed, bracket-nested
  search params (`filter[status]=open&tags[0]=rust`) via `serde_qs`, with
  `parse_query_nested` / `query_to_string`.
- `Link` external-href support: `http(s):`, `mailto:` and `tel:` links are
  handed to the OS (`cx.open_url`) instead of the route tree.
- `Link::reset_scroll` is live: the flag flows through
  `NavigateOptions.reset_scroll` into scroll restoration.
- Scroll restoration v2: entries keyed by path + canonicalized search string,
  capacity-bounded store (default 128, oldest evicted,
  `ScrollRestoration::set_capacity`), and the router-level
  `scroll_restoration: false` flag is honored.
- Model-based randomized navigation suite: a seeded xorshift RNG drives
  hundreds of random op sequences through `RouterCore` against a
  `Vec` + cursor history model, asserting the `current_match` ⇔ location
  invariant at every step (dependency-free, deterministic, headless).
- Workspace lint policy codified in `[workspace.lints]` (pedantic warn,
  `unsafe_code` deny) inherited by every crate via `[lints] workspace = true`.
- Lean dev profile (`debug = "line-tables-only"`, no incremental caches) to
  cut `target/` size by more than half.

### Changed

- Route matching is zero-copy: the trie stores `Arc<RouteNode>` and
  `match_path` / `current_match` hand out `Arc` clones instead of deep-cloned
  nodes.
- `serde_html_form` was evaluated for nested params but only supports flat
  maps and repeated keys, so `serde_qs` 1.1 is the `nested-search` dependency.
- CI: clippy uses the in-repo workspace lints (`-D warnings`), lints/tests
  every optional feature (`validator`, `garde`, `validify`, `valico`,
  `nested-search`), and all GitHub Actions are pinned to the latest majors
  (`checkout@v7`, `upload/download-artifact@v7`, `git-cliff-action@v4`,
  `action-gh-release@v3`, `rust-cache@v2`, `install-action@v2`).

### Fixed

- History traversal (`back`/`forward`/`go`, including inside transactions)
  never re-matched the route tree, so the UI kept rendering the stale route
  after a back navigation. Traversal now re-resolves `current_match` in the
  core and mirrors it into `RouterState`.
- Dead `#[allow(dead_code)]` fields removed: the devtools cache table no
  longer carries an unused `TypeId` column and the example blocker state no
  longer stores an unused `FocusHandle`.
- Feature-gated lint debt: the `validify` integration iterated a shared slice
  with `into_iter()`, and the `valico` integration duplicated the raw-params
  JSON conversion (now the shared `raw_to_json` helper).

### Performance

- `Arc`-shared route nodes make matching and `current_match` copies pointer
  bumps (no callback/metadata/pattern clones per navigation).
- Idempotent codegen output, cached scanner regexes and single-match
  navigation (`navigate_with`) from the original audit remain in place.
